title: Barron Approximation and locally optimal weight densities for shallow neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.19798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mean field theories provide optimization results for shallow neural networks by analyzing the weight distribution in infinite width limits. Corresponding results for finite sized networks are obtained by particle approximations, for which sharp quantitative bounds are still an open problem.   In this paper, we consider a modified mean field loss, which allows a more fine grained control over finite sized networks. We prove convexity and equidistribution properties, which directly lead to Barron type approximation results for networks sampled from local loss minimizers. We demonstrate that particle approximations of the new loss function naturally lead to gradient descent methods with dropout type regularization.

translated_title: 浅层神经网络的Barron逼近与局部最优权重密度
translated_abstract: 平均场理论通过分析无限宽度极限下的权重分布，为浅层神经网络提供了优化结果。有限规模网络的相应结果则通过粒子近似获得，但针对粒子近似的精确定量界仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们考虑了一种修正的平均场损失，它允许对有限规模网络进行更细粒度的控制。我们证明了该损失的凸性和均衡分布性质，这直接导出了从局部损失最小化器采样所得网络的Barron型逼近结果。我们还证明，新损失函数的粒子近似自然地引出了带有dropout类型正则化的梯度下降方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种修正的平均场损失，证明其凸性与均衡分布性质从而获得有限规模网络的Barron型逼近保证，并表明其粒子近似自然导出带dropout型正则化的梯度下降方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modified mean field loss with proven convexity and equidistribution properties that yields Barron-type approximation guarantees for finite-sized networks, and shows that its particle approximations naturally lead to gradient descent with dropout-type regularization.
